old: Doubtful: (1) tribhāga taken as 'a third part' (could be 'three parts'). (2) tad-ardha-aṃśika: 'half that quantity'; which members are meant to be at half the quantity is a judgement from pratyekam. (3) 'trikaṭuka equal to the decoction' is literal; the odd quantity is not corrected here. (4) the base liquid is the decoction of unit 56. Identifications (reading of this unit stays low confidence; only the surest names enriched): trikaṭuka = śuṇṭhī (Zingiber officinale), pippalī (Piper longum), marica (Piper nigrum) (standard). vatsaka = kuṭaja, Holarrhena pubescens (Buch.-Ham.)
